_comment: Curated catalogue of Anthropic Claude models the ``claude`` CLI can target via --model. Append a new entry to surface it in the picker; the adapter loads this file at startup. Aliases (haiku/sonnet/opus) come first so they are the recommended choice; explicit version ids follow for operators who want to pin a specific release. Edit this file or set $STRATOCLAVE_LOOM_CLAUDE_MODELS to point at an external file.

models.name: Claude Haiku (latest)
models.description: Cheapest / fastest tier; CLI alias resolves to the current Haiku release.

models.name: Claude Sonnet (latest)
models.description: Balanced default; CLI alias resolves to the current Sonnet release.

models.name: Claude Opus (latest)
models.description: Most capable tier; CLI alias resolves to the current Opus release.
